title: Linear endomorphisms from unique local scalar sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_X-algebras [def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module], p:B → C an algebra morphism, and I a sheaf of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with an inclusion i:I → B in a short exact sequence 0 → I → B → C → 0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Suppose the product of any two sections killed by p is zero on every open. Then there is a family α_U:C(U) → End_{O_X(U)}(I(U)) of functions, satisfying i(α_U(p(b))(x))=b*i(x) and commuting with all restriction maps. No additive, multiplicative or unit laws in the argument from C(U) are asserted.

proof.text: Apply the unique scalar-section theorem pointwise. The defining formula proves additivity and scalar linearity after applying the injective kernel map; uniqueness proves restriction compatibility.

theorem square_zero_glued_linear_operators (X : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (p : B ⟶ C)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (i : I ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B)
    (hw : i ≫ (commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk i ((commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p) hw).ShortExact)
    (hsq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (x y : B.right.obj.obj (op U)),
      p.right.hom.app (op U) x = 0 → p.right.hom.app (op U) y = 0 → x * y = 0) :
    ∃ (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, C.right.obj.obj (op U) →
        Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (I.val.obj (op U))),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) (σ U (p.right.hom.app (op U) b) x)) =
          b * @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) x)) ∧
      (∀ (U V : X.Opens) (j : V ⟶ U) (f : C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        I.val.map j.op (σ U f x) = σ V (C.right.obj.map j.op f) (I.val.map j.op x))
